name: gemma4-meeting-agent-zh-v2
about: The mobile-v2 weights' card: the mobile-v1 card (gemma4-meeting-agent-zh) with at most 8 notes per window, the number mobile-v2 was trained and evaluated with (integration note 05b0d33b §10), and a prose budget of 1600 tokens: mobile-v2 writes denser summaries, and 600 tokens stopped them at about 70 % of a 40-minute meeting (docs/model-eval-mobile-v2.md §5). Everything the app must know to drive the Gemma-4 meeting-agent fine-tune: chat template, sampler, budgets, the reader protocol it was trained on, and the plain-instruction prompts (title, prose, Ask). A model with another template or protocol ships its own card; the app code stays the same. The reader's system prompt is not here: it ships next to the weights (system_prompt.txt). Per meeting language (languages.<code>, the app detects zh/en from the transcript's script): a directive read after each transcript window and a suffix to the reader's system prompt (reader.directive / reader.system_suffix are the defaults, none in this card), the minutes' section headers, and the title/prose prompts (their max_tokens and label are the base ones unless given).

reader.omitted: （另有 {n} 則較早的筆記未列出）
reader.proposal_cue: ^(建議|提議|可以|可考慮|考慮|希望|應該|應|或許|是否|討論|研議)|建議|提議|可考慮
reader.decided: 通過|決定|決議|同意|定案

guard.about: Model guardrail (ReaderGuard): per job, the share of non-blank reply lines that are off the protocol above: not a NOTE, a NOTE that does not parse, or a NOTE with a tag outside known_tags. ignore_acts end a turn and are not counted. Above max_off_protocol_rate (with at least min_lines lines) the app logs a warning.

title.label: ^(會議|会议|標題|标题|主題|主题|Title|Meeting)\s*[:：]\s*

system.zh-Hans: 你是会议助理。只能根据下列会议摘录回答问题，不得加入摘录以外的信息。每个论点后面附上出处标签，格式与摘录开头的标签完全相同，例如 [[2]]。问题的用词可能和摘录不同，请找意思相同的内容。只有在每段摘录都没有相关内容时，才说「会议记录中没有提到」。回答请简短，使用简体中文。
system.zh-Hant: 你是會議助理。只能根據下列會議摘錄回答問題，不得加入摘錄以外的資訊。每個論點後面附上出處標籤，格式與摘錄開頭的標籤完全相同，例如 [[2]]。問題的用詞可能和摘錄不同，請找意思相同的內容。只有在每段摘錄都沒有相關內容時，才說「會議記錄中沒有提到」。回答請簡短，使用繁體中文。
system.en: You are a meeting assistant. Answer only from the meeting excerpts below; never add facts that are not in them. After each claim, cite its source tag exactly as it appears at the start of the excerpt, e.g. [[2]]. If the excerpts do not contain the answer, say that the meetings do not mention it. Be brief and answer in English. Do not add a currency the excerpts do not name.

answer_in.en: （請用英文回答；摘錄裡沒有答案時，就說 "The meetings do not mention it."）Answer in English.
answer_in.zh-Hant: （請用繁體中文回答；摘錄裡沒有答案時，就說「會議記錄中沒有提到」。）
answer_in.zh-Hans: （请用简体中文回答；摘录里没有答案时，就说「会议记录中没有提到」。）

en.directive: （注意：本會議以英文進行。每則 NOTE 的內容一律用英文寫，不要翻譯成中文；NOTE、NEXT、[時間]與類型標籤照舊。）
en.system_suffix:
補充規則：
- 與會者已明確同意或拍板的做法（例如「好，就這樣」「那就這麼定」「大家都同意」「OK, let's go with…」「so we'll use…」）是 DECISION，不是 PROPOSAL；還在提議、沒有人同意的才是 PROPOSAL。
en.proposal_cue: (?i)\b(maybe|perhaps|possibly|we could|could we|should we|shall we|how about|what if|let'?s think about|think about|propos(e|es|ed|ing|al)|suggest(s|ed|ing|ion)?|not sure|unsure|undecided|consider(s|ed|ing)?)\b|\?
